---
title: "Results: Dual-Target Multiplex Compatibility"
---

To enable simultaneous point-of-care detection of **Influenza A** and **Influenza B** in a single reaction tube, candidate assays designed for the Indonesian cohort were evaluated using the **Multiplex Compatibility Screening Engine** (`scripts/m11_multiplex_checker.py`).

The screening engine evaluates all pairwise heterodimerization thermodynamics ($\Delta G$), kinetic melting temperature alignment ($\Delta T_m$), and fluorophore channel separation across a 6-oligo reaction mixture ($\text{Fwd}_A, \text{Rev}_A, \text{Probe}_A, \text{Fwd}_B, \text{Rev}_B, \text{Probe}_B$).

---

## 1. Dual-Temperature Screening Regimes

To guarantee assay robustness, **100 candidate combinations** ($10 \times 10$ matrix of top Influenza A MP and Influenza B MP candidates) were evaluated across two temperature regimes:

1.  **Isothermal RT-RAA Mode ($39.0^\circ\text{C}$)**: Primary operational temperature for point-of-care recombinase-mediated amplification.
2.  **qPCR Comparative Benchmark ($55.0^\circ\text{C}$)**: Gold-standard laboratory thermal cycling benchmark.

---

## 2. Top Recommended Multiplex Assay Combinations

The table below highlights the top 5 multiplex combinations ranked by candidate selection gates (combining coverage, specificity, and multiplex compatibility scores), accounting for cross-dimer penalties, 3'-end anchoring, and kinetic alignment:

| Rank | Candidate Pair | Compatibility Score | RAA ΔG (39°C) | 3' Anchor | qPCR ΔG (55°C) | ΔTm (°C) | Status (39°C) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **1** | **`FluA_Rank10_x_FluB_Rank12`** | **64.5** | **-7.19 kcal/mol** | **5 bp** | **-3.49 kcal/mol** | **2.23°C** | <span style="color: #10b981; font-weight: bold;">PASS</span> |
| **2** | **`FluA_Rank1_x_FluB_Rank12`** | **64.0** | **-7.19 kcal/mol** | **5 bp** | **-3.49 kcal/mol** | **2.42°C** | <span style="color: #10b981; font-weight: bold;">PASS</span> |
| **3** | **`FluA_Rank4_x_FluB_Rank12`** | **66.5** | **-7.19 kcal/mol** | **5 bp** | **-3.49 kcal/mol** | **1.59°C** | <span style="color: #10b981; font-weight: bold;">PASS</span> |
| **4** | **`FluA_Rank4_x_FluB_Rank8`** | **66.3** | **-7.19 kcal/mol** | **5 bp** | **-3.89 kcal/mol** | **1.63°C** | <span style="color: #10b981; font-weight: bold;">PASS</span> |
| **5** | **`FluA_Rank10_x_FluB_Rank8`** | **64.4** | **-7.19 kcal/mol** | **5 bp** | **-3.89 kcal/mol** | **2.27°C** | <span style="color: #10b981; font-weight: bold;">PASS</span> |

### Key Biophysical Observations:
*   **Zero Veto Violations**: All top combinations exhibit a worst-case cross-dimer binding energy $\Delta G > -12.0\text{ kcal/mol}$ (worst observed $\Delta G = -7.19\text{ kcal/mol}$), preventing spontaneous primer-dimer formation or competition during strand exchange.
*   **3'-End Safety**: All 3' complementarity runs remain $\le 5\text{ bp}$, well below the threshold for priming non-specific noise.
*   **Kinetic Balance**: $T_m$ differences across all primers in the multiplex mixture stay within acceptable bounds for isothermal and thermal cycling regimes.
*   **Fluorophore Independence**: Influenza A probe uses FAM ($\lambda_{\text{em}} = 520\text{ nm}$) and Influenza B probe uses HEX ($\lambda_{\text{em}} = 556\text{ nm}$), eliminating optical crosstalk.

## 3. Oligo Synthesis Specifications (Rank 1 Recommended Pair: `FluA_Rank10_x_FluB_Rank12`)

To ensure full transparency and laboratory synthesis readiness, the complete sequence strings, lengths, melting temperatures ($T_m$), GC percentages, and fluorophore dye modifications for all 6 oligos in the primary recommended multiplex set are listed below:

### 🟩 Target A: Influenza A MP (FAM Channel)

| Oligo Name | Type | IUPAC Degenerate Sequence (5' $\rightarrow$ 3') | Length | Tm (°C) | GC (%) | Modification / Tag |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **FluA_Fwd** | Forward Primer | `TCTGACTAARGGRATTTTRGGRTTTGTATTC` | 31 nt | 61.8°C | 35.5% | Unlabeled |
| **FluA_Rev** | Reverse Primer | `GCAGTTAAACTATATARGAARCTGAARAGRG` | 31 nt | 60.6°C | 35.5% | Unlabeled |
| **FluA_Probe** | Exo-Probe | `CCGTGCCCAGTGAGCGAGGACTGCAGCGTAGACGC[FAM-dT][THF][BHQ1-dT]GTCCAAAATGCCCT[C3-spacer]` | 51 nt | 82.3°C | 61.8% | Internal `FAM-dT`/`THF`/`BHQ1-dT` sandwich, `3'-C3-spacer` |

### 🟨 Target B: Influenza B MP (HEX Channel)

| Oligo Name | Type | IUPAC Degenerate Sequence (5' $\rightarrow$ 3') | Length | Tm (°C) | GC (%) | Modification / Tag |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **FluB_Fwd** | Forward Primer | `CTCTTGTGAAGAAATAYCTATAATGYTYGAA` | 31 nt | 59.5°C | 30.6% | Unlabeled |
| **FluB_Rev** | Reverse Primer | `AAGAGACAATAAACAGAGAGGTATCAATTTT` | 31 nt | 59.9°C | 29.0% | Unlabeled |
| **FluB_Probe** | Exo-Probe | `TGTTCTTTTATCTTATCAGCTCTCCATT[HEX-dT]C[THF][BHQ1-dT]GGCTTGGACAATAGGGCA[C3-spacer]` | 49 nt | 71.5°C | 38.8% | Internal `HEX-dT`/`THF`/`BHQ1-dT` sandwich, `3'-C3-spacer` |

## 4. Oligo Cross-Dimer Interactions (Rank 1 Assay: `FluA_Rank10_x_FluB_Rank12`)

Below is the complete 9-pair inter-assay cross-dimer thermodynamic breakdown for the primary recommended multiplex set:

| Oligo Pair Combination | Cross-Dimer ΔG (39°C RT-RAA) | 3' Anchor Run | 3'-End ΔG (39°C) | Cross-Dimer ΔG (55°C qPCR) | Risk Assessment |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Forward A vs. Forward B** | -4.07 kcal/mol | 3 bp | -2.30 kcal/mol | -1.88 kcal/mol | <span style="color: #10b981; font-weight: bold;">Negligible</span> |
| **Forward A vs. Reverse B** | -3.13 kcal/mol | 3 bp | -1.63 kcal/mol | -1.72 kcal/mol | <span style="color: #10b981; font-weight: bold;">Negligible</span> |
| **Forward A vs. Probe B** | -3.09 kcal/mol | 2 bp | -1.63 kcal/mol | -1.53 kcal/mol | <span style="color: #10b981; font-weight: bold;">Negligible</span> |
| **Reverse A vs. Forward B** | -5.27 kcal/mol | 5 bp | -3.94 kcal/mol | -2.30 kcal/mol | <span style="color: #10b981; font-weight: bold;">Low / Safe</span> |
| **Reverse A vs. Reverse B** | -3.95 kcal/mol | 4 bp | -1.35 kcal/mol | -2.47 kcal/mol | <span style="color: #10b981; font-weight: bold;">Negligible</span> |
| **Reverse A vs. Probe B** | -5.69 kcal/mol | 5 bp | -3.82 kcal/mol | -3.49 kcal/mol | <span style="color: #10b981; font-weight: bold;">Low / Safe</span> |
| **Probe A vs. Forward B** | -4.77 kcal/mol | 2 bp | -4.77 kcal/mol | -2.83 kcal/mol | <span style="color: #10b981; font-weight: bold;">Negligible</span> |
| **Probe A vs. Reverse B** | -3.45 kcal/mol | 5 bp | -1.49 kcal/mol | -1.82 kcal/mol | <span style="color: #10b981; font-weight: bold;">Negligible</span> |
| **Probe A vs. Probe B** | -7.19 kcal/mol | 4 bp | -5.08 kcal/mol | -3.44 kcal/mol | <span style="color: #10b981; font-weight: bold;">Low / Safe</span> |

## 5. Dynamic N-Plex Compatibility Results (Expandable Multi-Virus Panels)

To enable single-reaction surveillance across expanded target panels (**Influenza A**, **Influenza B**, **Measles**, and future pathogen targets), top candidate assays from each active target build are evaluated dynamically across an **N-Plex reaction mixture** (e.g. 9-oligo mixture for 3 targets: 6 primers + 3 probes). 

Depending on clinical or regional surveillance priorities (e.g., executing a **Dual-Target Influenza A/B assay** vs. a **3-Virus Respiratory/Exanthem Panel**), the pipeline automatically filters and calculates cross-dimer thermodynamics for the requested target subset.

### Recommended 3-Target Panel Combinations (Triplex Benchmark)

| Rank | Triplex Candidate Set | Compatibility Score | Worst RAA ΔG (39°C) | Worst qPCR ΔG (55°C) | Max ΔTm (°C) | Status (39°C) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **1** | **`FluA_R9_FluB_R14_Measles_R1`** | **66.7%** | **-6.90 kcal/mol** | **-4.98 kcal/mol** | **1.88°C** | <span style="color: #10b981; font-weight: bold;">PASS</span> |
| **2** | **`FluA_R9_FluB_R14_Measles_R2`** | **66.7%** | **-6.90 kcal/mol** | **-4.98 kcal/mol** | **1.88°C** | <span style="color: #10b981; font-weight: bold;">PASS</span> |
| **3** | **`FluA_R9_FluB_R14_Measles_R3`** | **66.7%** | **-6.90 kcal/mol** | **-4.98 kcal/mol** | **1.88°C** | <span style="color: #10b981; font-weight: bold;">PASS</span> |
| **4** | **`FluA_R9_FluB_R14_Measles_R5`** | **66.7%** | **-6.90 kcal/mol** | **-4.98 kcal/mol** | **1.88°C** | <span style="color: #10b981; font-weight: bold;">PASS</span> |
| **5** | **`FluA_R9_FluB_R14_Measles_R6`** | **66.7%** | **-6.90 kcal/mol** | **-4.98 kcal/mol** | **1.88°C** | <span style="color: #10b981; font-weight: bold;">PASS</span> |

> [!NOTE]
> **Interpreting the Two Temperature Columns**:
> Both thresholds use the same VETO criterion of $\Delta G \le -12.0$ kcal/mol, but RAA operates at 39°C where dimers are more thermodynamically stable. The qPCR column at 55°C confirms that the same combinations remain safe even at higher thermal cycling temperatures, validating cross-platform compatibility.
